speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. Agent; I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help you safely, how many weeks pregnant are you, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your pregnancy at 30 weeks, the sudden onset of fever and headache, and specifically the consumption of ice cream three days prior, have you noticed any visual disturbances like blurry vision or seeing spots, or any muscle weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection)

The history of eating ice cream three days before the sudden onset of fever, headache, and malaise in a third-trimester pregnant patient is highly suggestive of listeriosis. I will proceed with ordering blood cultures and a urinalysis to confirm the diagnosis.
